trigger.label: Customer didn't reply
trigger.hint: Fires when we send a message (agent or bot) and the customer doesn't answer within the set time. If the customer writes, the follow-up is cancelled.
trigger.lastCall: Last call before the window closes (23 h)
trigger.lastCallHint: WhatsApp, Instagram and Messenger only allow free-form messages up to 24 h after the customer's last message. After that, only approved WhatsApp templates.
trigger.handlerAi: Only those handled by an AI agent
trigger.handlerHuman: Only those handled by a person

step.label: AI follow-up
step.instructionsPlaceholder: E.g. remind them the promotion ends today
step.help: The AI writes a short message from the conversation, with the agent's personality and tone. It is only sent while the messaging window is still open.

issues.window_closed: At this step the customer will have been silent for at least {hours} h: the {channels} messaging window will be closed and the message won't be sent. Use "Send Template".
issues.window_closed_some: At this step the customer will have been silent for at least {hours} h: on {channels} the window will be closed and the message won't be sent there. Consider a template.
issues.template_whatsapp_only: Templates only work on WhatsApp channels.
issues.template_some_channels: Templates don't work on {channels}: this step will fail there.
issues.no_reply_amount: Set how long to wait (greater than 0).
issues.no_reply_channels: The channel list is not valid.
issues.no_reply_both_filters: Choose "only AI" or "only people", not both.
issues.ai_followup_agent: The selected agent is not valid.
